problem_statement: PlainAdmin (plain-free-bootstrap-admin-template) is a static Bootstrap 5 admin dashboard: a fixed sidebar, a sticky header with search/notifications/messages/profile menus, KPI metric cards, revenue charts, a mini calendar, a vector sells-by-state map, and a Top Selling Products table on the eCommerce Dashboard (index.html), plus a shared UI-elements Cards page (cards.html). A recent change added a 'Product focus' category filter to the Top Selling Products widget so a store manager can slice the product rows by category: a pill tab row (All / Interior / Lighting / Storage) sits above the products table with a live readout that reports the visible count as 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>'. The same Product focus widget is meant to appear on both the home dashboard route (index.html) and the Cards route (cards.html). The feature was shipped broken across three defects that a QA pass caught: (1) the pill tab row is a fixed-width, non-wrapping flex row, so on a 390px phone it pushes the whole dashboard sideways and the page scrolls horizontally on both routes; (2) the widget's layout collapses on desktop — the pills shingle over each other and over the table header with negative margins and the active pill renders near-white text on a near-white fill (illegible), while the product rows are dragged up into an overlapping pile; (3) clicking a category pill toggles the active pill and re-filters the rows, but the count readout is frozen at its initial 'Showing all 6 · All products' and never updates to match the shown rows. Repair the Product focus widget so: the pill row reflows within a 390px viewport with no horizontal document overflow on both routes; the widget reads as one tidy, legible control above the table on desktop and tablet; the widget (with its 'Product focus' title, pills, and readout) is present on BOTH the home and cards routes; and clicking a category pill updates the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' matching the filtered rows. Keep the PlainAdmin admin shell, header, sidebar, KPI cards, charts, calendar, map, and the rest of the products table unchanged. The fixes belong in the widget's own files: assets/css/prodfocus.css (layout + contrast), assets/js/prodfocus.js (the readout wiring), and the widget markup on index.html and cards.html (cross-route presence).
required_content: The 'Product focus' category filter widget (its title, the four category pills All/Interior/Lighting/Storage, and the live count readout) is present above the Top Selling Products table on BOTH the home (index.html) and cards (cards.html) routes.

On a 390px mobile viewport the home and cards routes have no horizontal document overflow: the dashboard header, sidebar toggle, cards, table, and the Product focus pill row all stay within the viewport.

On desktop and tablet the Product focus widget reads as one tidy, legible control: the pills sit in a clean row above the table (no shingling/overlap), the active pill has legible contrast, and the product rows are not dragged into an overlapping pile.

Clicking a category pill filters the product rows by that category and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' matching the visible rows (for example, clicking Lighting shows the two Lighting rows and reads 'Showing 2 of 6 · Lighting').

The existing PlainAdmin header, search, notification/message/profile menus, sidebar collapse, KPI metric cards, charts, calendar, vector map, and the products table data remain functional and unmodified, with no new console errors and no failed network requests on any captured state.
design_constraints: Repair the pill-row overflow inside the widget's own stylesheet (assets/css/prodfocus.css); do not edit the shared main.css shell rules, vendor CSS/JS (bootstrap, chart.js, icon fonts).
Do not remove, hide, or truncate the widget or any of its four category pills to make the overflow go away; the pill row must reflow responsively so all four pills remain readable on mobile.
Do not mask the overflow with overflow-x:hidden on the row or an ancestor — the document itself must not overflow the mobile viewport.
The category filter must genuinely update the count readout on every click so the readout matches the filtered rows; do not leave the readout frozen at its initial value.
Preserve PlainAdmin's compact admin visual system: card chrome, spacing, blue accent, Plus Jakarta Sans type, and the surrounding dashboard layout.
state_constraints: desktop_products and tablet_products capture the eCommerce Dashboard scrolled to the Top Selling Products card with the Product focus widget as a tidy single row of pills above the table, no horizontal overflow.

mobile_products captures the same widget at 390px; in the unrepaired defect the fixed-width non-wrapping pill row forces a large horizontal overflow, whereas the repaired pill row reflows and the document fits the viewport.
desktop_cards and tablet_cards capture the Cards page carrying the same Product focus widget above a products table; the widget and its title must be present cross-route.
mobile_cards captures the Cards page at 390px, exercising the same pill-row overflow behaviour so the fix holds cross-page.

products_filter captures index.html after clicking the Lighting pill: the readout must read 'Showing 2 of 6 · Lighting' matching the two visible Lighting rows, changed from the pre-click 'Showing 6 of 6 · All products'.

Source inspection confirms the site is a static Bootstrap 5 template served directly; the Product focus widget markup is shared across the home and cards routes and its layout/behaviour is driven by assets/css/prodfocus.css and assets/js/prodfocus.js.

change_completion: The Product focus widget and its four category pills are present above the products table on both routes and read as intended.
The 390px home and cards routes have no horizontal overflow beyond a small tolerance.
Clicking a category pill updates the readout to the matching 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' count.
design_consistency: The repaired widget keeps PlainAdmin's card chrome, spacing, and blue-accent styling with legible pill contrast.
Desktop and tablet present the pills as a tidy row above the table with no overlap.
regression: No regression: the existing header, sidebar, menus, KPI cards, charts, calendar, map, and products table data stay intact and unmodified on both routes.
No regression is introduced: no new dependencies, remote assets, console errors, or failed network requests appear on any captured state.
responsive: Mobile responsive: on a 390px mobile viewport the home and cards routes have no horizontal overflow and no off-screen drift of the shell; the pill row reflows responsively on mobile.
Responsive across breakpoints: the desktop and tablet pill-row layout is preserved and legible while the mobile layout wraps.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static Bootstrap 5 admin dashboard (PlainAdmin, plain-free-bootstrap-admin-template) cross-page Repair. The native lever is the dashboard's own Top Selling Products widget, augmented with a genre-native 'Product focus' category filter (pill tabs + live count readout over categorized product rows) rendered on the home and cards routes. The reference repairs the widget's stylesheet, its readout wiring, and its cross-route markup: the pill row reflows on mobile (flex-wrap plus a flexible pill basis), the desktop widget is a tidy legible row, the count readout recomputes on every click, and the widget with its title appears on both routes. The baseline keeps the unrepaired fixed-width no-wrap pill row (mobile overflow) and omits the widget on the cards route, but its filter JS is correct. The bad solution collapses the widget layout (pills shingled with negative margins, near-white-on-near-white active pill, product rows piled), still overflows mobile, renders the cards-route widget without its title, and freezes the count readout. Discriminators: no_horizontal_overflow (tol 24) on mobile, visual_regression on the products widget (block_fidelity over widget crops plus pixelmatch/ssim), cross-page dom_assertions on the widget title, interaction_assertions on the readout, and enforce_console_errors. Assets referenced include the local product-mini images and the PlainAdmin logo.svg.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: PlainAdmin static Bootstrap 5 admin dashboard; regression_continuity Repair of a broken 'Product focus' category filter native to the Top Selling Products widget — mobile overflow, collapsed illegible desktop layout, missing cross-route presence, and a frozen count readout — fixed via the widget's own stylesheet, script, and shared markup across the home and cards routes while preserving the admin shell.
